hooks.command: [ -f .claude/.deps-installed ] || { pip install -e ".[dev]" >/tmp/adagent-deps-install.log 2>&1 && mkdir -p .claude && touch .claude/.deps-installed && echo "adagent deps installed"; } || echo "adagent dep install failed, see /tmp/adagent-deps-install.log"
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) python3 -m ruff check --fix "$f"; case "$f" in */agent/*) python3 -m mypy "$f" ;; esac ;; esac; true
